gaps: Verify that the newly created event persists a 45-minute evaluation window after its 30-minute bidding time.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary instead of searching or creating another event.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the buyer flow.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order popup.
Verify that the Recreate Order popup opened.
Verify that the popup exposes the evaluation-duration control.
Confirm that 45 Mins is offered under Evaluation Duration.
Set the recreated order’s evaluation duration to 45 Mins.
Assert that the selected evaluation duration remains 45 Mins before creation.
Create the recreated order with the selected evaluation duration.
Verify that creating the recreated order did not produce an application error.
